g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Title: SWD / buttons / hardware service inhibit

g.desc: Title: SWD / buttons / hardware service inhibit

g.text: INTERLOCK: closed only in recording position

g.desc: INTERLOCK: closed only in recording position

g.text: SWD PROGRAMMING AND USB SERVICE: DISCONNECT ALL ELECTRODES

g.desc: SWD PROGRAMMING AND USB SERVICE: DISCONNECT ALL ELECTRODES

g.text: SERVICE_OK = USB absent . SWD absent . interlock closed. ADC_IO_READY = ANALOG_OK . DIGITAL_OK . ANA_ENABLE enables the ADC buffers.

g.desc: SERVICE_OK = USB absent . SWD absent . interlock closed. ADC_IO_READY = ANALOG_OK . DIGITAL_OK . ANA_ENABLE enables the ADC buffers.

g.text: Closed only in the recording position; open blocks acquisition through SERVICE_OK. Mechanical

g.desc: Closed only in the recording position; open blocks acquisition through SERVICE_OK. Mechanical

g.text: J300 pin 9 detection works only with adapters that ground it. SWD has no target-power input; 3V3 is a voltage reference only. No USB bootloader is assumed.

g.desc: J300 pin 9 detection works only with adapters that ground it. SWD has no target-power input; 3V3 is a voltage reference only. No USB bootloader is assumed.

g.text: A mechanical interlock is still required: an unpowered USB cable can join grounds without VBUS detection.

g.desc: A mechanical interlock is still required: an unpowered USB cable can join grounds without VBUS detection.

g.text: RESET pulls the supervised reset line; RECOVERY and RECORD are active-low GPIO with 10k pull-ups.

g.desc: RESET pulls the supervised reset line; RECOVERY and RECORD are active-low GPIO with 10k pull-ups.

g.text: Cortex 10-pin; 100R series on each line. Pin 9 grounded by a compatible adapter gives SWD_ABSENT low. No target power.

g.desc: Cortex 10-pin; 100R series on each line. Pin 9 grounded by a compatible adapter gives SWD_ABSENT low. No target power.
